name: Arista cEOS Lab Demo
description: Demonstration lab for Arista cEOS (containerized EOS) with NETCONF, gNMI, and eAPI management enabled. Shows how to build and run Arista container labs.
eval_notes: Arista cEOS requires registration at arista.com for image download. NETCONF server on port 830. Recommended: 8 vCPUs, 10GB RAM for 10+ containers. cEOS uses startup-config at clab-<lab>/node/flash/startup-config. Free download from arista.com with account. Native Docker container (no KVM needed). Full EOS CLI and API support. Widely used with containerlab for network automation testing.
